rules: No invented temperatures or heat numbers

lessons.title: Rivet Mastery
lessons.goal: One rivet row seated head by head. No tents or silvering after cool-down.
lessons.timeBox: 30 min drill: one rivet row on a scrap panel (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Oversized Panel Handling
lessons.goal: Hang one tall panel level with two people. Nobody stretches off a ladder.
lessons.timeBox: 45 min, two techs (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Class C RV Panel Walkaround
lessons.goal: Walk a finished RV and log every lift, gap, and stripe break before it leaves.
lessons.timeBox: 20 min walkaround (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Swing Door Workflow
lessons.goal: Graphic lines up across both doors. Hinge cuts are clean. Doors slam without lift.
lessons.timeBox: 45 min per door pair (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Prep & Cleaning — Dirt Traps
lessons.goal: A fresh white towel comes back clean. No residue at rivets, seals, or hardware.
lessons.timeBox: 20–30 min per side (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Deep Recess / Liftgate Tuck
lessons.goal: Liftgate recess fed and seated. No bridge over the plate pocket.
lessons.timeBox: 40 min per liftgate (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Sliding Door Alignment
lessons.goal: Bands line up across the slider, door shut and open. Nothing binds in the track.
lessons.timeBox: 45 min per side (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: RV/Bus Roof & Ladder Safety
lessons.goal: Tall work done from a locked platform, clear floor, two people. No top-cap standing.
lessons.timeBox: 10 min setup check before every high hang (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Rear Hinge Mapping
lessons.goal: Rear doors registered before the full liner comes off. Hinge cuts planned, not torn.
lessons.timeBox: 45 min per door pair (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Wet Soft-Seat Recess
lessons.goal: Recess soft-seated wet. No trapped fluid, grit, or corner puddles.
lessons.timeBox: 30 min per recess (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Architectural Panel Hang
lessons.goal: Pattern lines match across panels. Returns seated before any trim.
lessons.timeBox: 45 min per panel (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Cubby / Recess Registration
lessons.goal: Every bay matches the next: same reveal, same edge, same baseline.
lessons.timeBox: 15 min survey, then 20 min per bay (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Corner Trim / Edge Finish
lessons.goal: Clean knife line in the crease. No chewed edge. No lift after cool-down.
lessons.timeBox: 15 min drill: five corners (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Trailer Rivet Rows
lessons.goal: Rivet rows seated after alignment. No scorched transfer tape. No tents.
lessons.timeBox: 30 min per row section (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Trailer Tall-Side Roofline
lessons.goal: Top edge runs straight the full length. Seams shed water.
lessons.timeBox: 20 min layout before the hang (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Door Hinge Cutting
lessons.goal: Hinge cuts land in the void. No paint scores. Door cycles clean.
lessons.timeBox: 20 min per hinge set (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Panel Segmentation
lessons.goal: Segments line up. No logo cut through a seam. QC between every segment.
lessons.timeBox: 15 min planning, then QC after each segment (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Fleet Alignment Rules
lessons.goal: Unit 2 matches unit 1 on your fleet sheet. Photo proof.
lessons.timeBox: 15 min measure card per unit (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Multi-Vehicle Workflow
lessons.goal: Every panel labeled by unit. Nothing leaves without QC sign-off.
lessons.timeBox: 10 min intake per vehicle (starting target — set your own)

lessons.title: Fleet Quality Control
lessons.goal: Same checklist, same photos, every unit. Lead signs off.
lessons.timeBox: 15 min per unit (starting target — set your own)

workflows.title: Box Truck
workflows.summary: Rivet fields, oversized panels, roll-up and swing doors.

workflows.title: Van
workflows.summary: Deep recesses, sliding doors, roof safety, rear hinges.

workflows.title: Trailer
workflows.summary: Rivet rows, roofline, door hinges, panel segmentation.

workflows.title: Storefront/Architectural
workflows.summary: Wet install, architectural panels, multi-pane, interior wraps.

workflows.title: RV/Bus
workflows.summary: Tall sides, awnings, ladders, large-panel hang.
